name: Regulatory Sandbox (FinTech / Innovation Testbed)
description: A regulatory sandbox is a supervised real-world environment where companies can test innovative products, services, business models, and delivery mechanisms without immediately encountering all usual regulatory consequences. As defined by the Inter-American Development Bank (IADB), these environments involve real customers and regulators, creating high-stakes, live interactive conditions for evaluating novel technologies including AI-enabled systems. They serve as ultimate real-world testbeds for assessing safety, reliability, and societal impact before widespread deployment.
reputation: Formalized regulatory mechanism adopted globally (UK FCA, Singapore MAS, IADB, etc.); considered the gold standard for real-world pre-deployment validation of novel financial and AI technologies.
notes: Not a computational benchmark but a policy and evaluation framework. Involves real users and regulators, making evaluation outcomes dependent on uncontrolled real-world dynamics. Invaluable for assessing AI societal impact that simulations cannot capture.
